review_evidence: README identifies a complete Lean 4 + mathlib formalization of the Feit-Thompson Odd Order Theorem, with an axiom-clean theorem that every finite group of odd order is solvable.

The 1,706 primary Lean files form a large finite-group-theory library covering the Feit-Thompson proof, character theory, modular representation theory, local analysis, and full result-by-result formalizations of several source texts and cited papers.

The repository reports that all Lean sources are sorry-free and every numbered result of the three principal books has been formalized; no current-primary subtree can be discarded without losing unique proof/search content.
summary: Retain the full Odd Order/Feit-Thompson formalization and its extensive supporting finite-group theory library.

review_evidence: Extracted 1377 paths from the brief; all end in .lean; directory counts: Peterfalvi 407, GroupTheory 336, Isaacs 215, BG 205, Higman 141, Algebra 61, Mathlib 5, 7 top-level files.

Declaration-keyword grep over every listed file: 1374 files have at least one declaration; only OddOrder.lean, OddOrder/Peterfalvi/S01_Introduction.lean and OddOrder/Peterfalvi/S02_Notation.lean have none.
OddOrder.lean (61452 bytes): all non-blank lines outside the copyright header are import lines; pure import aggregator, retained per FILTER-007.

OddOrder/Peterfalvi/S01_Introduction.lean (6879 bytes): module docstring describing Peterfalvi section 1, the proof strategy and prerequisites, then namespace OddOrder.Peterfalvi.S01 ... end with comments only; retained as navigation documentation with no verified auxiliary channel.

OddOrder/Peterfalvi/S02_Notation.lean (7604 bytes): docstring notation correspondence table (TI-subset -> OddOrder.GroupTheory.IsTISubset, Dade isometry, coherence, Fitting/opCore names) then an empty namespace OddOrder.Peterfalvi.S02; retained for the same reason.

OddOrder/AxiomsCheck.lean (1407998 bytes, largest): defines OddOrder.AxiomsCheck.allowedStandard and isAllowed, an elab command #assert_only_allowed_axioms, and 6030 assertion lines naming project theorems (e.g. Subgroup.normalClosure_eq_iSup_map_conj); contains definitions, retained.

Smallest files (OddOrder/BG/AppC_LemmaC2.lean 1646 bytes, Isaacs/Ch08_PermutationGroups/Problems8C/AbelianAut.lean 1712 bytes, Algebra/TraceIsCompl.lean 2072 bytes) all have declarations per the grep.

Largest ordinary files (e.g. BG/Ch4_FamilyOfMaximal/S15_MF/Corollary155.lean 92159 bytes, Peterfalvi/S11_MaximalII_III_IV/SummandComplementKernel.lean 91629 bytes) are declaration-bearing proof files.
summary: Surveyed all 1377 listed files (all .lean, 41.4 MB total): OddOrder/Peterfalvi 407, OddOrder/GroupTheory 336, OddOrder/Isaacs 215, OddOrder/BG 205, OddOrder/Higman 141, OddOrder/Algebra 61, OddOrder/Mathlib 5, plus OddOrder.lean, OddOrder/AxiomsCheck.lean and five OddOrder/FeitThompson*.lean files. No build scripts, tests, benchmark data, or vendored code are in the list. A per-file grep for Lean declaration keywords (theorem, lemma, def, structure, class, instance, inductive, abbrev, example, axiom, opaque, with modifiers) found declarations in 1374 files. The three files without declarations were inspected: OddOrder.lean is a pure import aggregator (retained under FILTER-007, no verified auxiliary channel), and Peterfalvi S01_Introduction and S02_Notation are long module docstrings with a namespace block that map Peterfalvi notation and prerequisites to the Lean names that implement them; this is navigation documentation, and no auxiliary channel that would keep it searchable is verified, so FILTER-004 case 1 is not met. The 1.4 MB AxiomsCheck.lean defines an axiom allowlist and a custom command and names 6030 project theorems in axiom assertions, so it stays. All files are retained.
